detail.title: Thermodynamic and Stoichiometric Constraints in Chemical Memory
detail.summary: This journal entry revises our understanding of how non-equilibrium persistence in chemical networks separates into mere hysteresis versus encoded heritable memory, focusing on algebraic stoichiometric conditions.
